name: Black & Gold Hand-Painted Acrylic Calligraphy
short_desc: This rustic Islamic wall accent features the sacred Shahada (La ilaha illallah) in bold white and gold script set into a dark panel framed by natural reclaimed wood. Protected with a gloss varnish seal, it brings warmth and vintage charm to cozy farmhouse-style interiors.
seo_title: Rustic Reclaimed Wood Shahada Islamic Art – Black & Gold Hand-Painted Acrylic Calligraphy
description:
Combine sacred tradition with warm interior design through this unique hand-painted Shahada calligraphy piece. The artwork displays the foundational Islamic declaration—La ilaha illallah Muhammadur Rasulullah—in elegant Arabic typography across a horizontal center.

Using premium acrylic paints, the central composition blends a rich black and gold background panel with clean white script and metallic gold scrollwork accents. Mounted directly into a distressed, natural reclaimed wood feature frame, the warm brown grain creates an inviting, cozy contrast with the dark art panel.

The painting is finished with a protective gloss varnish seal, preserving the vibrant paint work against wear, dust, and color fading while adding a refined sheen under warm lighting.

This piece is an ideal fit for rustic living rooms, cozy home libraries, wood-accented dining areas, or farmhouse-inspired decor spaces.

Key Specifications & Features:

Medium & Materials: Heavy-body acrylic paints mounted on a rustic wood panel structure

Surface Coating: Protective gloss varnish seal for color protection and moisture resistance

Theme & Script: Shahada (La ilaha illallah Muhammadur Rasulullah)

Color Palette: Matte black background, bold white script, metallic gold flourishes, and warm reclaimed wood tones

Style: Rustic Farmhouse / Vintage Islamic Art

Ideal Placement: Wood-paneled wall, cozy living room, dining area, or country-style home
